name: simple-trade
description: Crossline (project `simple-trade`) scans Binance USDⓈ-M futures for Supertrend(10, 3) flips confirmed by EMA 50 and RSI(14) on one configurable timeframe (default 30m). Each signal becomes a limit order at the signal candle's low or high, with a fixed take profit and stop loss. The app follows every order through fill and exit, and keeps a running win rate, fill rate and result in R.
